verdict.rationale: Brevo documents true batch operations. One API request can send up to 1000 personalized email versions, batch requests support idempotency keys to prevent duplicates, and contact lists can be imported and updated programmatically. Missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete operations for other item types such as contacts, deals and campaigns, explicit bulk support via the MCP/AI-assistant interface, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Send up to 1000 personalized email versions in a single API request
Prevent duplicate emails by using idempotency keys in batch transactional email requests
Send customized emails to multiple recipients in a single request.
Import, update, and organize your contact lists programmatically.
